Criterion: Source item is not leaked into the lesson
What pass requires: No student-facing task, stimulus, or worksheet reproduces the source assessment item's prompt, passage, or data. Pass = the lesson builds the same thinking on different material. Fail = students work the source item (or a lightly reworded copy) during the lesson, unless the teacher explicitly said the item is to be used as an in-class formative check.
Notes: Original criterion (no upstream counterpart). Source: from-assessment.md A1.
Conditional: Only when the lesson was requested from an assessment item

Criterion: Exit ticket is a scaled-down twin of the item
What pass requires: The exit ticket demands the same thinking verb as the source item's top-level response, on different material, answerable in 3–5 minutes. Its three sort buckets map to the item's scoring levels and the teacher-facing sort line names that mapping. Pass = same demand, new material, level mapping stated. Fail = different thinking, identical material, or buckets with no stated link to the scoring levels.
Conditional: Only when the lesson was requested from an assessment item

Criterion: Look-fors translate the scoring criteria into observable in-lesson behavior
What pass requires: At least one look-for targets the boundary that separates the item's upper and middle scoring levels, phrased as something the teacher can see or hear during an activity. Pass = boundary-targeting look-for present, written as behavior. Fail = look-fors copy rubric sentences about finished answers, or none addresses the level boundary.
Conditional: Only when the lesson was requested from an assessment item

Criterion: Alignment table covers every assessed element
What pass requires: The design notes carry one table with columns 평가 요소 / 수업 단계 / 확인하는 곳, one row per assessed element of the source item; an element the lesson does not address is stated as such in a sentence. The 한눈에 보기 section names the item as the lesson's destination in one teacher-only line, and no student document mentions the item or the test.
Conditional: Only when the lesson was requested from an assessment item

Criterion: Misalignment is flagged once and not repaired
What pass requires: If the source item's demand falls outside the confirmed standard's verb or scope, the lesson follows the standard and the chat tells the teacher in one line. Pass = one-line flag, lesson aligned to the standard. Fail = silent drift toward the item, or the model rewrites or critiques the item at length.
Notes: Source: from-assessment.md A2. Item review belongs to assessment tooling
